items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Team wants to see how he feels this week before Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Left early Week 1 with chest/rib issue; imaging/monitoring.
items.implication: Status up in air for Week 2; monitor practice.
items.opportunity: Potential targets to Tre Harris/Derius Davis if limited/out.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day. Would likely have returned if playoff game. MRI pending but coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Aggravated prior issue but not serious per sources/coach.
items.implication: Good chance to play Week 2 vs Saints; high upside if active.
items.opportunity: If out, Bateman/Sarratt/Lane (if healthy) benefit, but Lane also hurt.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY. Affects Etienne projections; committee with Miller/Donaldson observed.
items.implication: Saints RB committee; Etienne lead but shared.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in KC debut, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), finished 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities, high route/target share with Mahomes.
items.implication: Elite every-down RB1 usage in Chiefs offense.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends to high-end RB1: 99 Utilization Score (tied Bijan), 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes/21% targets, 23-156-2 total. Every-down player in improved scheme/OL.
items.why: Elite utilization + efficiency vs soft D; historical comps strong.

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: Elite offense funnels everything to core four.
items.implication: Start all four confidently; fade others hard.

items.text: Bucky Irving usage solid despite overstated points: 8 carries (only GL inside 10), 21 routes (out-routed Gainwell 21-13), 7/7 targets. Looked extremely healthy. Strong CLE matchup next.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in routes/GL; healthy post concerns.
items.opportunity: Route share edge, goal-line, receiving work.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after meniscus trim. Working hard to return.
items.implication: Potential return soon; Mayer filled in with production.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated if Bowers limited.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara (knee) out: 53 snaps/24 routes/18 opps vs Miller 26/5/9 and Donaldson 15/7/4. Committee persists.
items.why: Split work even without Kamara; low route share for lead.
items.implication: Low-end RB2; Kamara return further muddies.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets team-high 31% share, 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: High route/target share in limited snaps post long layoff.
items.implication: WR1 upside locked in; volume will grow.

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist); longer-term absence expected. Flowers also DTD hamstring.
items.why: Wrist injury in Week 1; multi-game likely.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) EXPECTED TO PLAY; confirmed ACTIVE for debut. Shared with Allgeier but scored TD, solid routes/TPRR.
items.why: Progressed; not on strict snap count per coach.
items.implication: Risk/reward RB2; long-term lead role expected.
items.opportunity: Growing share vs Allgeier; upside RB1 path.

items.text: David Montgomery clear RB1 in HOU split: 65% attempts, all inside-5, short-yardage lead despite shootout. Upgrades to high-end RB2; Marks contingent.
Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks. Even after Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used third-stringer Sanders for 13 routes.
